title: vivo X300 E is official with Zeiss-backed triple-rear cameras, Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC
summary: vivo has launched the X300 E in China, powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 and running Android 16-based OriginOS 6. The phone features a Zeiss-backed triple rear camera array including two 50MP sensors, a 7,200mAh battery with 90W charging, Wi-Fi 7, and an IP69 rating. Pricing starts at CNY 4,799.
content:
vivo’s latest X300 series phone has gone official in China. The vivo X300 E is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset and features a Zeiss-backed triple-rear camera setup.

The handset sports a 6.59-inch OLED screen with a 1.5K resolution, up to a 144Hz refresh rate, and a peak brightness of up to 5,000 nits. It also includes an under-display ultrasonic fingerprint scanner.

Under the hood, the vivo X300 E pairs the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 with LPDDR5X RAM and UFS 4.1 storage. The phone ships with OriginOS 6 based on Android 16 out of the box.

Photography hardware centers on a Zeiss-backed triple-rear camera system: a 50MP Sony IMX921 primary sensor, a 50MP Sony IMX882 periscope telephoto camera, and an 8MP ultrawide module. For selfies, the device uses a 50MP Samsung JN1 sensor with autofocus.

A large 7,200mAh battery provides extended runtime and supports 90W wired fast charging. The X300 E also offers stereo speakers and an IP69 ingress protection rating.

Connectivity features include Wi-Fi 7, dual SIM 5G capability, Bluetooth 5.4, GPS, NFC, and an IR blaster.

The phone measures up to 7.99mm in thickness and weighs around 203 grams depending on the color finish. Available color options are Midnight Black, Moonlight White, and Sunlight Orange.

Pricing in China starts at CNY 4,799 (approximately $710) for the 12GB/256GB model, while the 12GB/512GB variant is priced at CNY 5,299 (approximately $785).

Source: GSMArena (author: Siddharth).
